personality_one_liner: A youthful, energetic, and highly touchable digital classroom that turns managing homework and class chat into a modern, engaging experience.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets, rounded layouts, soft clustering instead of rigid lists.

do's: Sticky headers over scrolling homework lists

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a quick overview of urgent deadlines, recent announcements, and quick access to games and members.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored spinner with youthful bounce animation.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty desk; 'Nothing happening right now!'
states.error: Oops! Could not load the class data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with Class Logo (left) and notifications/profile (right). 'Up Next' hero card at the top (urgent homework or test). 2-column quick action grid for 'Members' and 'Duck Jump' minigame. Horizontal scrolling list for Announcements. Floating Action Button for Admins to post.

screens.name: Calendar & Homework
screens.purpose: A triage-based hub to see what is due, sorted by urgency.

states.loading: Skeleton of a weekly calendar strip and task cards.
states.empty: Backpack on a desk illustration; 'All caught up! No homework due.'
states.error: Failed to load schedule. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Swipable weekly calendar strip at the top. Below, a list of assignment cards. Each card has a color-coded subject chip, title, due date, and a circular checkbox for personal completion status. Sticky FAB to add homework (Admin).

screens.name: Class Chat
screens.purpose: Central communication hub for students to chat, react, and view pinned messages.

states.empty: Illustration of two friends; 'Start the conversation!'

screens.layout: Pinned messages at the top in a horizontal scroll or a collapsed accordion. Standard chat interface below with message bubbles (rounded corners, brand-tinted for user, surfaceSecondary for others). Input field at the bottom with attachment (Materials) button.

screens.name: Admin Panel & Settings
screens.purpose: Allow the class representative to customize the class experience and manage users.

states.empty: N/A - always has static config options.

screens.layout: List layout with tinted icon containers. Sections: Class Customization (Color picker, Logo upload, Name), Subjects Management, Users List, Invite Code sharing. Language Switch (IT/EN). Logout at the bottom.

empty_homework.alt: School desk with opened books and a backpack

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app in React Native using Expo.
Implement bottom tab navigation: Home, Calendar, Materials, Chat.
Ensure 'blu/viola' (Blue/Purple) is used as the default brand color, as explicitly requested by the user. Use #7C3AED (Violet) for primary and #3B82F6 (Blue) for secondary.
Design with the 'Tactile / Playful' personality. Use chunky rounded cards (lg/pill radius), soft shadow tiers, and slightly offset asymmetrical layouts for a youthful vibe.
Implement language switching (Italian/English). Ensure UI can accommodate both lengths.
Calendar should have a weekly swipable view on top, followed by interactive task cards with personal completion checkboxes.
For Chat, ensure pinned messages are clearly visible at the top, and include reaction placeholders.
Duck Jump minigame is a feature on the Home Dashboard (or a separate modal), ensure it has a leaderboard UI.
Admin panel must include options to change colors (just a UI mock of a color picker is fine) and view the invite code.
Do NOT use indigo/purple for other generic apps, but HERE it is allowed because the user literally specified 'blu/viola come default'.
